title: WL-SeqVAE: Sequence-Based Graph Generation Using Variational Autoencoders and Weisfeiler-Leman Colors
abstract: arXiv:2610.32650v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In this paper, we introduce WL-SeqVAE, a sequence-based variational autoencoder for generating graphs. The key observation behind WL-SeqVAE is that node colors induced by the Weisfeiler-Leman (WL) algorithm provide compact discrete summaries of local graph structure and can therefore serve as structural tokens for generation. Rather than learning a distribution over adjacency matrices directly, our method maps each graph to a sequence of WL colors and employs a variational autoencoder that encodes this sequence into a Gaussian latent distribution, from which an autoregressive decoder reconstructs the graph. During generation, compatibility constraints derived from the WL colors guide node and edge predictions, combining global information from the latent representation with local structural consistency. translated_title: WL-SeqVAE：基于序列的图生成方法——利用变分自编码器与Weisfeiler-Leman颜色
translated_abstract: 本文提出了WL-SeqVAE，一种用于图生成的基于序列的变分自编码器。WL-SeqVAE背后的关键观察是：由Weisfeiler-Leman（WL）算法诱导的节点颜色为局部图结构提供了紧凑的离散摘要，因此可以作为生成过程中的结构化标记。我们的方法并不直接学习邻接矩阵上的分布，而是将每个图映射为WL颜色序列，并采用变分自编码器将该序列编码为高斯潜在分布，再由自回归解码器从该分布中重构出图。在生成过程中，由WL颜色导出的兼容性约束引导节点和边的预测，将来自潜在表示的全局信息与局部结构一致性相结合。这一方法将图生成问题转化为序列生成问题，避免了对二次方规模的邻接矩阵进行直接参数化。
tldr: 该论文提出WL-SeqVAE，将图转换为Weisfeiler-Leman颜色序列并用变分自编码器和自回归解码器建模，把图生成转化为序列生成问题，同时借助WL颜色兼容性约束保证局部结构一致性，从而避免直接参数化大规模邻接矩阵。
en_tdlr: WL-SeqVAE reformulates graph generation as sequence generation by mapping graphs to Weisfeiler-Leman color sequences encoded in a variational autoencoder, using WL-derived compatibility constraints to guide autoregressive graph reconstruction while avoiding direct parameterization of quadratic adjacency matrices.
